name: Design Intelligence Source Registry
description: A curated registry of design inspiration and design intelligence sources for autonomous crawling, pattern extraction, trend detection and research. Extended with three sources added after the original registry (21st.dev, Godly, Motionsites.ai), and a precomputed weighted_score on every entry using the registry's own source_weight_formula (freshness converted from its qualitative label via low=2, medium=5, high=8, very_high=10, since reference-curator has no code-execution tool to compute this live).

sources.name: CIUSLABS (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: Scroll-built illustration performing the idea (process as a structure assembling); torn-edge world change; grain; blur-to-sharp text

sources.name: Later homepage (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: One brand polygon across components; proof by volume (real UGC video wall); pinned depth scenes with floating UI cards; disciplined lazy video

sources.name: Later: Made You Look (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: Page staged as its medium (film): honest preloader, title card, credits, horizontal reel, vertical type chapter markers

sources.name: BMW Next Move by Format-3 (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: Entry ritual that unlocks a sound system; cinematic footage; morphing line geometry; stages with prev/next; colour-coded sees/underneath explanation

sources.name: Goofy Mew by Mint Playground (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: Light real-time 3D product (three.js + crisp label art) you can spin and read; claw-machine game as the product picker

sources.name: Mint Playground, Trang's portfolio (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: Pre-rendered 3D hero character scrubbed by scroll (192-frame canvas sequence) telling the designer's promise as a short story

sources.name: Dispersion by oavivo (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: Procedural WebGL2 SDF glass object refracting the page's own headline per colour channel; scroll morphs material with a live readout; zero assets

sources.name: Hope novel by G.D. Colwill (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: Diegetic scroll meter (distance to impact) in the nav that hits 0 at a pinned climax; page ordered as a stakes arc; proof strip in the hero; low-tech, high concept

sources.name: Mr.BLACK franchise case by Dolganev (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: 3D product as a persistent guide object across chapters; exact qualified figures around it; stacked option cards; typewriter voice for terms; mixed glTF + image sequence

sources.name: Two26 Studio (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: Founders as collage characters with a style shift on scroll; reading fill with a leading edge; marginalia stickers; services as one self-drawing route; voice at every seam

sources.name: Primary brand studio (exemplar)
sources.primary_value: Restraint as premium: one face, black/white, one meaningful accent with a mark; one metaphor (sprint) through name, copy, icon and CTA; outcomes as captions; argument as a chart; label-to-bar hover

fastidious_ids: L-001 to L-004 are reserved for the third-party skill packages Fastidious builds on; L-005 to L-089 are the 85 registry sources and L-090 to L-100 the exemplar sites.
